name: Meowdoku!
description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

Key Features
• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

- Colorful Visuals: Bright and gorgeous design makes every puzzle a joy to solve.

Block Out! is designed for puzzle lovers who enjoy both strategy and action. Download Block Out! now and explore the dynamic world of colorful puzzles.

name: Magic Sort!
description:
Discover Magic Sort! Mix colors in a world where every splash of water is a step into mystery. This isn’t just a game; it’s a journey through puzzles that sparkle with charm, inviting you to sort, match, and puzzle your way through.

Quick Play Guide

- Start Simple: Tap a bottle to pick it up, and another to pour the water. Organize the water so each bottle has only one color.
- Think Ahead: Pour water only if it matches the top color of the destination bottle and there’s room. Plan to avoid dead ends and strategically sort the colors.
- Embrace Complexity: With each level, sorting and matching require more thought. Every move is crucial.
- Utilize Magic Tools: Stuck? Use 'Undo' to reverse moves, or 'Shuffle' to rearrange the bottles anew, making sorting a breeze.

- Spellbinding Levels: Each stage brings a fresh challenge of color sorting and magical fun.
- Wizard’s Gear: Magic tools make your quest of water sorting smoother and way more fun.
- Vivid Splashes: A riot of colors makes every move a delight, turning sorting into a visual feast.
- Unique Twists: Classic puzzles get a magical makeover for extra thrill, blending color, water, and puzzle elements seamlessly.
- Boosts & Surprises: Stir up boosts in the cauldron to power through puzzles, adding a layer of strategy to your color sorting.
- Mystical Ingredients: Gather ingredients to brew stronger magic, enhancing your water sort adventures.

Why Play Magic Sort?

- Sharpen Your Brain: Each puzzle is a fun test of wits, blending elements of color, water, and sorting into each challenge.
- Chill Vibes: Dive into a soothing, colorful escape, where water and color sorting provide a tranquil experience.

Get Ready to Cast Some Color! 

Download Magic Sort now and start your magical, colorful journey. The world of mystical puzzles, where water, sorting, and color converge, awaits!

CHESS COMMUNITY:

name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

name: Colony Flow!
description:
Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Tap a box to send its ants marching
- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest
- Manage your five slots — don't let them clog
- Unlock the boxes buried further down the stack
- Clear every block to finish the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO SOLVE

- One-tap controls — start playing in seconds
- Puzzles that grow from cozy to genuinely clever
- No timers, no lives, no pressure — take as long as you like
- Watch trails of ants stream across the board as your plan pays off
- Every solved board reveals the picture hiding underneath

DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals, fruit, food, flowers, nature, festivals, toys, rockets, castles, and plenty more surprises. Every puzzle you finish adds another piece of pixel art to your collection, so there's always one more picture waiting to be uncovered.

With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

Tap the right boxes, guide your ants, clear the blocks, and uncover beautiful pixel art. Your colony is waiting!

YOUR CITY AS THE GAME WORLD

FROM YOUR FIRST BUS LINE TO A FULL NETWORK

THE RIGHT VEHICLES FOR YOUR LINES

GOOD CONNECTIONS, HAPPY PASSENGERS

YOUR COMPANY, YOUR DECISIONS
Set ticket prices, keep track of revenue and operating costs, and invest in your next expansion. Choose operating hours and run your fleet automatically or tailored to the time of day. Strike the balance between an attractive service and a profitable operation.

GROW WITH EVERY SUCCESS

Turn your first line into a network that connects your city.

name: Pixel Flow!
developer: Loom Games Oyun Yazilim ve Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

Observe the interlockedstructures, rotate each ring, and line up the hidden gaps to break the locks layer by layer. Simple to learn, deeply satisfying to master.
HOW TO PLAY
• Rotate: Tap and drag to spin rings to the target angle.
• Align: Match the open gaps across multiple layers.
• Untangle: Free the interlocking loops one by one.
• Solve: Plan your moves carefully to clear stages efficiently.
KEY FEATURES
• Satisfying Tactile Feel: Smoothphysics, fluid animations, and crisp unlock feedback.
• Clever Mechanics: Master diverse shapes — C-locks, D-rings, S-flex links, and triangle frames.
• Hundreds of Levels: Thoughtfully handcrafted puzzles with a smooth difficulty curve.
• Smart Boosters: Stuck on a complex knot? Use hints to reveal the next move.
Ready to untangle the chaos? Download Rotate Rings today and test your spatial logic!

name: Sort Streak: Color Puzzle
description:
SORT STREAK: COLOR PUZZLE

Sort, match, and arrange colorful flowers in a satisfying sorting puzzle adventure!

Sort Streak is a relaxing color sorting puzzle game and matching game that combines simple drag-and-drop gameplay with thoughtful planning. Colorful flowers are arranged on ropes, and your goal is to sort flowers by color, match them to the right rope, complete objectives, and fill flower pots.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every move matters. Rearrange the flowers, manage limited rope space, and find the best solution for every puzzle level. Whether you want to relax or train your logical thinking, Sort Parade offers a colorful and satisfying puzzle challenge.

HOW TO PLAY

• Pick up a flower or a connected group of flowers from a rope.
• Drag the flowers onto an empty rope.
• You can also place them onto a rope with the same color at its free end and enough space.
• Sort and match flowers by color while carefully planning each move.
• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.
• Complete all objectives and fill the required pots to clear the level.

Every move can change the entire board. Look ahead, rearrange the flowers, and use the available rope space wisely. If there are no legal moves left, the level ends. Can you overcome every sorting challenge and complete the objectives?

WHY YOU’LL LOVE SORT STREAK

• Relaxing color sorting gameplay that is easy to learn.
• Simple drag-and-drop controls for an intuitive matching game experience.
• Colorful flowers, ropes, and satisfying sorting animations.
• Puzzle levels ranging from easy introductions to challenging arrangements.
• Different levels and layouts that keep the sorting adventure fresh.
• Helpful tools, including Hint, Undo, and Add a Rope.
• Satisfying flower grouping and flower pot collection feedback.
• A casual puzzle game for a quick break or a longer gameplay session.
• A fun way to practice logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving.

SPECIAL PUZZLE MECHANICS

Mystery Flowers add surprise to your color sorting adventure. Move the flowers underneath to bring a Mystery Flower to the end of the rope and reveal its true color. Once revealed, the flower can be sorted and matched according to the color rules.

Locked Flowers create new obstacles and objectives. Locked flowers cannot be moved until you complete the required color objective or the required number of group objectives. Unlock new possibilities, rearrange the ropes, and find a way through each challenging puzzle level.

As you progress, the flower arrangements become more complex. You will need to read the flower order, overcome obstacles, manage limited space, and choose every move carefully.

SORT, MATCH, AND TRAIN YOUR BRAIN

Sort Streak gives you a peaceful break while encouraging logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving. Take your time to sort colorful flowers, match the right colors, complete objectives, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of solving a puzzle.

Whether you enjoy sorting games, matching games, color sorting puzzles, brain teasers, or casual puzzle games, Sort Parade offers an easy-to-learn experience with satisfying challenges for every puzzle fan.

Can you sort every flower, overcome every obstacle, unlock every possibility, fill every flower pot, and complete the parade? 
Start playing Sort Streak today and enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle adventure!

name: Police Chief
description:
The world is shrouded in crime. Cities teem with gangs, smuggling rings, and assassin syndicates — citizens live in fear. As the newly appointed police chief, you must start small and strategically expand a local precinct while safeguarding the city. Grow your reputation step by step: expand office space, establish new departments, streamline paperwork, recruit elite officers, and equip your team with top-tier gear to tackle increasingly complex cases. Transform a modest station into a prestigious law enforcement headquarters!

1. Design & Build Your Police HQ
Build an empire of justice from the ground up! Freely arrange facilities such as interrogation rooms, holding cells, and armories to optimize investigations. Every brick you lay brings the city closer to order.

2. Recruit Officers & Upgrade Gear
Assemble a dream team of elite officers to dismantle criminal schemes. Invest resources in advanced weaponry and vehicles to handle escalating threats.

3. Investigate Cases Strategically
Intimidation or incentives? Choose interrogation strategies and adapt your approach to each suspect. As your caseload grows, you’ll face off against notorious criminals and deploy SWAT teams to bring them to justice!

4. Manage Inmates
More inmates mean more federal funding, but they also require meticulous oversight. Classify inmates by risk level, assign them to segregated housing, and maintain vigilant patrols to prevent jailbreaks.

5. Crush Prison Riots
Poor meals, cramped cells, or lax surveillance can spark violent uprisings. Mobilize rapid-response teams in riot gear to suppress them before they tank your reputation and funding!

Key Features:

Strategic Depth: Balance budget, reputation, and security in a dynamic crime ecosystem.
Progression System: Evolve from a rundown precinct to a high-tech law enforcement center.
Realistic Challenges: Adapt to gang wars, hostage crises, and corruption scandals.
Can you bring the streets back from the brink? The city’s fate rests in your hands.

• Random mock tests which select 24 questions to be answered in 45 minutes – just like the real test
• Practice mode which focuses on questions from each category
• Progress section that analyses your test results so you can review your answers and identify areas for improvement
• Key products tab to shop other official products in the range.

An essential practice app for anyone:
• Taking the Life in the UK British Citizenship Test
• Wanting to apply for British citizenship or settlement
• Teaching English or basic skills to refugees, immigrants or prospective applicants for British citizenship or settlement.

This app has been created by TSO – the publisher of the official Life in the UK Test learning aids. The questions are provided by the Home Office, the people who set the citizenship test.

Please note: To fully prepare for your test, this app should be used in conjunction with the 'Life in the United Kingdom: A Guide for New Residents, 3rd Edition' handbook.

description:

name: Shadowrocket
description:
Rule based proxy utility client for iPhone/iPad.

- Capture all HTTP/HTTPS/TCP traffic from any applications on your device, and redirect to the proxy server.
- Record and display HTTP, HTTPS, DNS requests from your iOS devices.
- Configure rules using domain match, domain suffix, domain keyword, CIDR IP range, and/or GeoIP lookup.
- Measure traffic usage and network speed on WiFi, cellular, direct and proxy connections.
- Import rule files from URL or iCloud Drive.
- Block ads by domain, user agent rules.
- Local DNS Mapping.
- Work on cellular networks.
- Decrypt HTTPS traffic.
- Perform URL rewrite.
- Fully IPv6 supports.
- Script filter supports.
- Multi-level forward proxy.
- Support kcptun, cloak, gost, v2ray plugins.
- Support DNS over HTTPS, DNS over TLS, DNS over QUIC.

name: AnkiMobile Flashcards
description:
Your decks, wherever you go! AnkiMobile is the official Anki app for iPhone and iPad, the flashcard app that more than 15 million learners worldwide have loved and trusted for over 20 years, made by the team behind Anki and AnkiWeb. Your purchase directly supports the open-source project that keeps Anki desktop free for everyone. Sync is included at no extra cost: no subscription, no sync fees. 

What you get:
 - Free sync with AnkiWeb. Keep your decks and study progress in sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Linux, and the web. Add cards on your computer, study them on your phone.
 - The same SM-2 and FSRS scheduling as desktop Anki, so you review material right as you're about to forget it.
 - A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study.
 - Detailed graphs and statistics about your progress.
 - Support for large collections, including 100,000+ cards.
 - Offline study. Media (images and audio) is stored on your device.
 - Powerful search for building filtered decks, e.g. "tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days, and not containing these words".
 - MathJax equations and LaTeX rendering.
 - Apple Pencil support for adding hand-drawn images to cards.

Good to know: AnkiMobile works alongside the desktop version of Anki. Some tasks might require the desktop version, and add-ons are not supported on mobile yet.
Sync is optional. You can also import and export data over USB or AirDrop.

Buy once and use AnkiMobile on all your devices with the same Apple ID. Family Sharing is also supported. Educational institutions can find bulk discounts information through Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

Need help? The manual and support resources are at https://docs.ankiweb.net/ankimobile/support. If you have questions or want to report an issue, contact us through our support site.

name: Site Audit Pro
description:
‘The fastest way to audit on the go’

Site Audit Pro helps thousands of businesses worldwide improve their productivity by making audits and inspections quicker to carry out and easier to manage. Whether performing a safety inspection, snagging issues, creating a punch list, or providing a quotation, Site Audit Pro will help you collate and share your findings on the go with customised Reports to add a personal and professional touch.

---

FEATURES

- Record Issues: Add a title, assignee, and comments to document each Issue.
- Add and Annotate Images: Highlight and draw important information directly on Images to emphasise key points.
- Organise Issues into Projects: Add Site and Client details specific to each Project for better organisation and clarity.
- Image Details: Optionally show timestamps and GPS locations on each Image in the Report for precise documentation of when and where Issues were recorded.
- Share Professional Audit Reports: Eliminate the need to return to the office by sharing a PDF or CSV via email, Dropbox, device file sharing, and more.

---

CUSTOMISATIONS

- Add personal details to your Reports; include Company Name, Logo, Auditor Name and Signature.
- Change the content to reflect your industry. Instead of ‘Identified 12 Issues’, why not use ‘Found 12 Problems’ or ‘Examined 12 Properties’?
- Choose from and customise a range of 8 professional Report designs.

---

GREAT FOR

- Audits
- Inspections
- Punch Lists
- Snag Lists
- Documenting various items

Site Audit Pro is adaptable to a number of industries. Whenever you need to capture and report important data, choose Site Audit Pro.

Download Site Audit Pro today to save time, improve productivity and make audits and inspections organised and hassle-free.

---

SUBSCRIPTION

Site Audit Pro Cloud is our subscription service that allows you to store your projects in the cloud and access them from the web. Whilst the subscription does give you access to some of the more advanced features and access, it is not required to use and generate Reports. The features below are what you would gain access to by subscribing, whereas the features above are what are already included in the base app.

SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES

1. ACCESS PROJECTS FROM THE WEB

Create, edit and share Reports from our web app. Using the website allows you to quickly type up comments using your computer keyboard as well as accessing your Projects from any browser.

2. MULTIPLE IMAGES

You can show more than one Image for each Issue. This is useful for showing several angles of the same Issue, or to compare before and after Images.

3. SYNCING

Sync your projects between devices. Start your project with your iPhone, type it up on an iPad, and do final editing on your PC or laptop. Reports can be generated from any location.

4. FOLDERS

Organise your Projects into Folders. Name your Folders after the property, area, client, group, site or anything you want to keep organised!

5. MORE PROJECT INFORMATION

Add a site address for each Project, as well as a Project photo to give the finishing touch to your Report’s cover.

6. ISSUE DUE DATES

Give Issues a Due Date so your Assignees know exactly how long they have to complete any tasks required.

7. COMPLETE ISSUES

Mark your Issues as completed. If all your Issues are completed, you can even mark the whole Project as completed.

8. REPORT COLOURS

In addition to more themes, you can set up your own colour scheme! Use this to match your company branding or specific report types. 

---

*** Subscription Information ***

Subscriptions will automatically renew unless cancelled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your Apple account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

*** Subscription Terms ***

You can find the terms and conditions of the subscription here:

https://www.siteauditpro.com/terms

name: Chromagraph Camera
description:
Replace your phone camera’s default processing with bespoke, curated color and texture rendering designed by cinematographer Steve Yedlin and used on the Knives Out films.

Chromagraph starts from raw image data and builds the image its own way: not a filter laid over the usual look processing, but a different process from the start.

(Chromagraph is a stills-only camera; it does not shoot video. Note that on some devices such as the iPhone 11, not all cameras support raw capture and will not be usable in Chromagraph)

SHOOT FIRST, SEE THE LOOK AFTER
As with a film camera, you frame through the viewfinder and see the finished look only after the image is processed. Take the picture, then open the gallery to see it with the Chromagraph look applied.

ADJUST WITHOUT LOSING THE LOOK
Intuitive yet powerful tools for color, tone, and texture give you real control while keeping every image true to the look that’s the core of the app.

A GALLERY THAT KEEPS THE ORIGINALS
Store full-quality raw files and view them in the app with the look applied live, along with any adjustments you make. Export smaller files to share with friends or save to your photo library, or turn on auto-export in Preferences to send every photo to your library right away as a JPEG or HEIC with the look applied.

NOT A FILTER
A filter sits on top of the processing your phone has already done. Chromagraph skips that processing and uses its own methods for the curated look preferred by director Rian Johnson and cinematographer Steve Yedlin.

name: TypeDraw
description:
Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

name: Tiny Computers
description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: ROLLIE'S: 35mm Film Camera
description:
A little camera shop in your pocket.

Choose a camera. Pick a lens. Load a roll. Every combination has its own look, baked live into the viewfinder before you ever press the shutter. No sliders, no presets to scroll: you compose the feel by choosing your gear, the way you would with real film.

A roll is 36 shots, and there is always another: every film on the shelf is yours, roll after roll.

• A real optical pipeline — body colour science, lens character, and film stock, layered the way light actually stacks up
• Live viewfinder preview: what you see is what develops
• 100 film stocks, each with its own mood — pastel, golden, green, black & white and more
• Everything is included — no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases
• Your photos stay on your device unless you post them to PHOTO PARADE. No account, no sign-in.

Shoot your day the way it felt.

name: Manager for Scooters
description:
Unlock the full potential of your e-scooter with Manager for Scooters – the ultimate unofficial companion app designed specifically for KuKirin vehicles. Get access to advanced live telemetry, complete customization, and technical guidance right on your iPhone.
Key Features:
Real-time Telemetry: Monitor current speed, motor output, and vital trip statistics live while riding.
Advanced Battery Diagnostics: Track precise cell voltage and charge percentage to optimize your range and performance.
Riding Mode Switcher: Seamlessly toggle between Eco, Sport, and Race modes to adapt your dynamics to any urban terrain.
Smart Vehicle Control: Toggle features like Cruise Control and Zero Start directly from a clean, minimalist interface.
Built-in Guides & Tutorials: Access step-by-step video and text instructions for everything from unboxing to tire changes, brake adjustments, and controller replacements.
Designed for maximum readability, the distraction-free dashboard offers direct control and total visibility into your scooter’s hardware state – built natively without bloated web frameworks.
No hidden subscriptions, no ad trackers, and no mandatory cloud account registration. Pay once, pair via Bluetooth, and hit the road.
Compatibility: KuKirin G2 / G2 Master (2025/2026) / G3 / G4

Any use of the registered trademark "KuKirin" is strictly for identification purposes. This application is independent and not affiliated with Shenzhen KuKirin Technology Co., Ltd.

name: HappyCow - Vegan Food Near You
description:
Discover the Best Vegan and Vegetarian Restaurants Anywhere!

For over 25 years, HappyCow has been the number 1 guide for finding delicious plant-based, healthy dining options wherever you go. With over 240,000 listings in 185 countries, we make it easy to explore the world of vegan and vegetarian cuisine.

Key Features:
• Powerful Search & Filters: Find restaurants near you, and plan trips ahead. Filter by vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, raw cuisine, and more!
• Interactive Maps: Explore popular and “hidden gem” restaurants on our community-curated maps. Save favorites for offline access.
• Extensive Reviews: Access 1,875,000+ restaurant reviews and 3,000,000+ photos from others like you

• 9 Languages:  Access main app features in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin, and Cantonese. 

Why HappyCow?
• We’re the world’s largest vegan platform, with an established 25 year legacy!
• Travel confidently with extensive global coverage and user-generated content.
• Find the best vegan food near you with detailed reviews, photos, directions and more.
• Our passionate community of over 1.2 million is here to support you no matter where you go. 


Discover plant-based, healthy dining in a new way, and never miss the best dining experiences near you!

Don't see your favorite vegan or vegetarian spot?
List it on HappyCow and help grow our ever-expanding database!

If you’re having trouble with the app, contact us at ios@happycow.net before leaving a review. We're here to help!

Download HappyCow now and unlock a world of delicious plant-based adventures!

name: LocoPast: The History Map
description:
Something incredible happened where you're standing right now.

We built LocoPast because we kept wondering about the places around us. Every street, building, coastline and landscape has a story, but discovering those stories often meant searching through books, articles and websites. LocoPast is a way to open a map and instantly see the history beneath your feet.

LocoPast is the location-based history map app. We transform the world into an interactive map of human history. Open the app and discover the battles, revolutions, inventions, disasters, cultural movements, scandals and forgotten stories that happened exactly where you're standing - or anywhere else on Earth.

History isn't just something that happened somewhere else. It's all around us. Whether you're exploring your local area, travelling abroad, or simply curious about a place you've never visited, LocoPast reveals the events that shaped the landscapes, cities and communities we see today.

With LocoPast, you can:

• Discover historical events near your current location
• Explore any place in the world
• Browse a global, interactive history map
• Listen to hands-free audio guides of each historical event or site
• Travel through centuries of events connected to real locations
• Open source articles for deeper context and further reading

Every event is linked to the place where it happened, turning ordinary locations into gateways to the past. As you move across the map, new stories appear automatically, creating a continuous journey of discovery.

Explore events including:

• Battles and military history
• Art, culture and creative movements
• Political events and revolutions
• Scientific discoveries and innovation
• Architecture and landmarks
• Religion and belief systems
• Crime, scandals and mysteries
• Natural disasters and major world events
• Industry, commerce and economic history

The next time you look at a street, a square, a river or a landmark, you'll know something most people don't: What happened there.

Download LocoPast and uncover the hidden history of the world around you.

name: Blueprint 4-Track
description:
Great for demos, first takes, and fresh ideas: voice and guitar at the kitchen table, or a band passing one phone around the room.

The sound of the machine is built in. Each track has its own set of knobs and there is no undo.

  - Records from the built-in mic, a headset mic, or a USB audio interface.
  - Loops any section of a song so you can record a part over it.
  - Sends any track through a space echo with spring reverb.
  - Bends pitch and tempo together with a varispeed knob in the master panel.
  - Has track merging/clearing, punch-in recording, and a metronome with pre-roll.
  - Your recordings are WAV files saved on your phone. Share the mix, every track as its own WAV, or the whole session.
  - Works entirely offline and collects nothing.
  - Pay once. No subscription, no ads, no account.
  - Works on iPhone and iPad.

  TIPS

  - Overdub with wired headphones, so the mic doesn't pick up the other tracks.
  - Don't use Bluetooth headphones while recording: they add delay, and only play in mono.
  - Tap record while playing to punch in over a part you want to redo.
  - Hold the |‹ button to loop a section.
  - Tap the ? at the top left for a guide to the controls.

Blueprint is made by one person. If something feels confusing or missing, email max@blueprintdaw.com and I will answer. Follow along on instagram at @blueprintdaw.

name: Universalis
description:
Universalis is a missal and a breviary, and more besides. It gives you the Liturgy of the Hours (Divine Office) and the Mass for every day; plus valuable additional material. 

Tens of thousands of people use Universalis daily. Come and join them!

• Single purchase: the app lasts for ever. It does not need a subscription to make it work.
• No Internet needed: everything you need is already built in.
• No cleverness needed: each day, Universalis works out exactly what you need to see.
• View any date: past, present and future.
• Use your own local calendar: USA, Canada, Singapore, Ireland, and every diocese in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.
• Easy to read and use: a choice of fonts; big or small type; dark or light theme; page-turning or scrolling.
• Optional add-on: spoken audio read by real human beings (this needs a subscription: see below).
• Latin if you want it: by itself or alongside the English.
• Help and support: tips and instructions are included; or press “Contact Us” to send us a message, and we will reply.

EXTRA MATERIAL

• The “About Today” page tells you what saints are being celebrated today, worldwide. It includes reflections, biographies and illustrations.
• “Mass Today” gives you the Order of Mass and today’s readings and prayers, all in one page. Bishops have been known to use it to say Mass from their iPads!
• “Spiritual Reading” gathers the patristic and hagiographic readings for all the saints and feasts of the day.  
• “The Rosary” has a verse of Scripture for every Hail Mary of every Mystery. Spoken audio is included.
• Daily Books takes selected spiritual classics and presents them in daily instalments to focus and enrich your prayer life.
• Commentaries on the day’s Mass readings from a leading biblical scholar.

And more – Home Screen widgets; liturgical events for your iOS calendar; daily email service; copy and paste into other apps; reminders and alarms; Mass readings on your Apple Watch.

LITURGY OF THE HOURS (Divine Office)

The complete official Liturgy of the Hours of the Catholic Church, as used worldwide. Morning (Lauds), daytime (Terce, Sext and None), evening (Vespers), night (Compline) and the deeply reflective Office of Readings. Do as many or as few of them as you like.
• The psalms and canticles match the official English and American books. Scripture readings – United States: RSV. Elsewhere: Jerusalem Bible (with RSV as an optional add-on).

READINGS AT MASS

The exact prayers and readings at Mass for each day.
• England, Wales, Scotland: the official ESV version. 
• United States: the official NAB version. 
• Elsewhere: Jerusalem Bible readings and Grail psalms, as used at Mass in most of the English-speaking world.

OPTIONAL ADD-ON AUDIO (in-app purchase required)

Just press the button and listen! If you want to see what you are hearing, the text is highlighted to follow the sound. After an initial download, no Internet is required. Works with CarPlay too.

• Spoken English Liturgy of the Hours: every Hour of every day of every year. Monthly or annual subscription.
• Spoken English Mass Readings: First and Second Reading and the Gospel. Jerusalem Bible translation only. Monthly or annual subscription.

(You can listen to a sample before subscribing. Following App Store rules, subscriptions renew automatically but you can cancel auto-renewal at any time.)

• Sung Latin Compline (Night Prayer): by the boys of the Schola Cantorum of the London Oratory School. Single purchase.

--

Privacy policy and terms of service: universalis.com/n-ios-privacy.htm

name: DVSA Hazard Perception
description:
Struggling with the Hazard Perception section of your Theory Test? 

This app provides extra support and resources to help you ace your Hazard Perception test!

Improve your road safety awareness and hazard perception skills and be confident in knowing that you’re ready to pass! 

Whether you’re a learner or an experienced driver or rider, you can help make the roads safer by becoming more aware of potential hazards. 

HAZARD PERCEPTION

name: Life in the UK 2026 Test Prep
description:
The Life in the UK Citizenship Test is a computer-based exam constituting one of the requirements for anyone seeking naturalisation as a British citizen. It is meant to prove that the applicant has a sufficient knowledge of British life and sufficient proficiency in the English language. The test consists of 24 questions covering topics such as British values, history, traditions and everyday life.

You’ll be tested on information in the official handbook for the Life in the UK Test included in this app - this is the only book recommended to prepare for the test. You’ll have 45 minutes to answer 24 questions.

This app also contains many practice questions you will be asked in the citizenship test.

- 51 Practice Tests - 1200+ Practice Questions
- Summary of key material and facts
- View them in a random order in a mock test to simulate an actual exam
- Take a practice test and see if you can score well enough to pass the actual test
- Based on real test questions
- You can track how many questions you have done correctly, incorrectly, and get a final passing or failing score based on official passing grades
- Option to review all the test questions if you don't want to take the quiz (Question Bank feature)
- Track Past Test Results - Individual tests will be listed with pass or fail and your mark
- Send questions feedback directly from the app
- Test Timer - Track how long it takes for you to take the test
- Test Timer - On/Off option
- Get immediate feedback for correct or incorrect answers

Note: Remeber that you must book your Life in the UK Test online at least 3 days in advance. There is a fee to register. There are around 60 test centres in the UK - choose one of the 5 closest to where you live. If the centre isn’t close to where you live, you won’t be allowed to sit the test and you won’t get a refund. Remeber to bring proof of your address to the test. If you have covered all the material in this app - It should be a breeze!

name: Jungle Breaks
description:
Jungle Breaks is a dual-scene live performance groovebox built as the mobile workflow for old-school jungle, drum 'n' bass, and breakcore music enthusiasts.

Built as the powerful successor to the Amen Break Generator app, it expands on its original concepts by introducing MPC-style sampler pads, quantized pad loopers, and a comprehensive set of iconic samples: era-defining 1990s jungle breakbeats, chord pads and subbasses.

The dual-scene layout allows to run two complete, independent 16-pad setups in parallel — 32 pads total — each with its own samples, effects, and snapshots. With this you can easily blend two arrangements, build transitions, or extend a set on the fly. The app features state-saving snapshots for instant performance recall and runs standalone or as a synchronized AUv3 plugin inside an iOS host DAW.

Whether you're chopping the amen break on stage or building a session in the studio, Jungle Breaks keeps your hands on the sound instead of buried in menus.



Key features:

* Sampler playback modes: Choose between standard One-Shot Mode (with +/- 12 semitone tuning) and Sliced Mode, which auto-chops loops into user-defined clips.

* Independent DSP Routing: Group individual pads into 4 color-coded sub-mixes, running each through an independent sequential chain of DSP effects.

* Free-Play Mode — Jam over your samples with automatic tempo quantization, so live-triggered loops and effects always land on the beat (or lock to your host's MIDI clock as an AUv3).

* 32-Step Live Loopers: Capture and overdub live taps across integrated 16 loopers with three distinct launch modes (Start on Tap, Start Immediately, and Count-In) with adjustable tempo (60-240 BPM).

* Live loopers pattern editor: Edit your recorded midi events, step-by-step with 32-steps grid-style editor.  

* 16-Effect DSP Chain per Group — Every group runs its own independent signal chain of 16 tempo-synced effects, including a segment-shuffling Scrambler, a randomized-loop Juggler, a stutter Repeater, rhythmic Gater, Bitcrusher, Flanger, stereo Ping-Pong Delay, sweeping filters, vinyl-style Slowdown, and tempo-locked Reverse — 64 effect slots in total across all 4 groups.

* Scene Snapshots: Store and recall 4 snapshot slots per scene on the fly to capture exact sample maps, active looper patterns, and effect parameters perfectly quantized to the global tempo.

* Scene Snapshots — Capture your full pad, effect, and looper state into 4 instant-recall slots per scene, with automatic synced transitions between them.

* Save & Load Scenes — Store and reload complete performance setups as files, and swap them live mid-set without interrupting playback.

* AUv3 & MIDI Integration: Run natively or as an AUv3 plugin inside iOS host DAWs, utilizing full MIDI note maps for pad triggers, snapshot recalls, MIDI Transport, and dedicated scene stop/panic notes.

* Import your own loops and one-shots samples. App accepts custom WAV files (16/24 bit, mono/stereo)

name: FoldTick
description:
For iPhone Duo only.

Give your Duo an odometer. And a secret engine room.

That satisfying feeling of folding your Duo closed? Put a number on it. FoldTick turns everyday folds into a beautifully crafted split-flap counter, useful widgets and a growing picture of how you use your Duo.

MILESTONE CERTIFICATES
The FoldTick Office of Hinge Affairs takes your folds with entirely unnecessary seriousness. At 100, 500, 1,000, 5,000 and every 10,000 folds, claim a dated certificate with your name and an absurdly formal title. Share it as an image, save an A4 PDF or print it for the wall.

DUO ENGINE ROOM
Your Duo has a secret world inside. Unfold it and step into an imagined steampunk engine room of brass gears, winding springs and mysterious amber light. Gently move the hinge and the machinery turns with you. A glass bulb brightens as you move, then fades as you hold still, while mechanical flap displays show your hinge angle and lifetime fold count.

Made for the inner display, in portrait or landscape. A little mechanical theatre, powered by your folds.

A COUNTER WITH CHARACTER
Watch your lifetime total grow on a graphite split-flap display inspired by mechanical counters. See how close you are to your next milestone.

YOUR COUNT, WHERE YOU WANT IT
Home Screen widgets range from compact and wide counters to a medium Weekly Counter. The large Activity widget combines your lifetime count, seven-day chart and 30-day calendar. Main counters support Today or All time; the Activity widget shows All time. Widgets follow light and dark appearance while their flaps stay dark.

The Lock Screen 7-Day Counter comes in circular and rectangular sizes. It totals recorded folds from today and the previous six days. Tap a seven-day counter or Home Screen chart to open Activity. Widgets update automatically as folds are recorded.

A HEAD START FOR YOUR COUNTER
Folded your Duo before installing FoldTick? Add an estimate in Settings. It contributes to your lifetime total and milestones; daily activity and insights use recorded folds. Edit or clear the estimate any time.

SEE HOW YOUR DAY UNFOLDS
Explore hourly activity, a seven-day chart, a 30-day calendar and your latest folds. Personal insights show your daily average, busiest day and hour, and weekly change using up to 30 completed days.

SHARE A LITTLE OF YOUR RHYTHM
Turn your lifetime count, today's folds, seven-day chart, 30-day calendar or insights into a styled image. Save to Photos or choose where to share it. Nothing is posted automatically.

SET IT UP. LET IT TICK.
Add FoldTick's ready-made Record Fold shortcut, then turn on Automation. The illustrated guide walks through import, enabling, a one-fold check and an optional earlier-fold estimate. It links to Shortcuts on the App Store if needed. Existing working automations need no replacement. Once configured, Record Fold can count off-screen, including while your Duo is locked after its first unlock.

JUST YOUR FOLDS
No account. No ads. No subscriptions. No analytics service. History and insights stay on your device. Sharing is your choice.

IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY AND SETUP
Automatic counting requires iPhone Duo with iOS 27.1 or later and one enabled closing automation in Apple's Shortcuts app. Other iPhone models lack the required closing trigger.

Each closing action delivered by Shortcuts adds one fold cycle. Counting starts after setup; earlier folds and undelivered actions cannot be recovered. Insights exclude today, the first recording day and your Earlier folds estimate; weekly comparisons need 14 completed days. Days without received folds count as zero, including when an automation did not run. iOS schedules widget updates, so widgets may lag behind the saved count.

FoldTick is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. iPhone Duo is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: GOV.UK One Login
description:
You can use the GOV.UK One Login app to prove your identity to access some government services. It works by matching your face to your photo ID.

You can also use this app to save a digital version of your HM Armed Forces Veteran Card to your phone. 

In future you'll be able to save other digital documents, such as your driving licence. This is not available yet.

Before you start

You need to get this app if you’re:
• using a service on the GOV.UK website that asks you to prove your identity with GOV.UK One Login
• saving your digital Veteran Card to your phone

You’ll be guided to this app when it is time to use it.

What you need

You can use any of the following types of photo ID to prove your identity:

• UK passport
• non-UK passport with a biometric chip
• UK photocard driving licence that is valid

You can use an expired driving licence if it expired in the last 90 days and it was issued by DVLA.

You need to have your original photo ID with you. You cannot use a photocopy or digital copy.

You will also need:
• a well-lit area where you can take a good quality photograph
• an iPhone 8 or newer
• iOS 16.7 or higher

How it works

You'll need to sign in to the app with your GOV.UK One Login details. This links the app to the GOV.UK website so you can continue proving your identity.

If your photo ID is a passport you will:
• take a photo of your passport
• scan the biometric chip in your passport using your phone
• scan your face using your phone

If your photo ID is a driving licence you will:
• take a photo of your driving licence
• scan your face using your phone

What happens next

Once your information has been submitted in the app, you'll need to go back to the GOV.UK website, so you can finish proving your identity and access the service you were trying to use.
 
Privacy and security

The personal information you provide to prove your identity will not be saved either on the app or on your phone. We collect your data securely and delete it when it is no longer needed.
Digital documents you add to the app will be saved on your phone so you can access them whenever you need.

name: Telegram Messenger
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: Microsoft Authenticator
description:
Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication, passwordless, or password autofill. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work or school accounts.

Getting started with multi-factor authentication

Multi factor authentication (MFA)provides a second layer of security. When enabled, during login after entering your password, you’ll be asked for an additional way to prove it’s really you. Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The OTP codes have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The OTP doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.

Getting started with passwordless

Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.

Microsoft personal, work or school accounts

Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain organization resources. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each.

Microsoft Authenticator may request the following optional permissions, which require your consent. You can continue to use Microsoft Authenticator without granting these permissions. However, some features may be limited or unavailable. For more information, please see below:

- Face ID: To enable app lock and help protect your accounts
- Camera: To scan QR codes when adding accounts to Microsoft Authenticator.

Receive messages 
-------------------
You can get important messages from your GP surgery and other NHS services through the app. Turning on notifications can alert you to new messages.  

Manage services for other people 
--------------------------------- 
You can switch profiles to access services for other people in the NHS App, such as a child or family member. Your GP surgery needs to give you access and you must both share the same surgery.  

Log in securely 
---------------
The NHS App will guide you through setting up an NHS login if you do not have one already. You will be asked to prove who you are. The app will then securely connect to information from your NHS services.  If your iPhone or iPad supports Touch ID or Face ID, you can use it to log in, every time you use the app.

name: Google - More ways to search
description:
Download the Google app to find quick answers, explore your interests, and ask anything on your mind in any way. Try AI in Google Search with AI Mode, Lens, Search Live, and more.

Feature highlights*:

• AI Mode: Get AI-powered responses to your toughest questions with AI Mode–talk, type, or snap a photo to get started, and ask follow-up questions to dig deeper. You’ll continue to see a range of helpful links so you can keep exploring across the web.
• Google Lens: See something you like? Snap a photo and discover where to shop for it, find related images, and more. Refine your camera searches by adding words – whether you want those shoes but in ‘blue’, or want to learn how to ‘repair’ that broken bit on your bicycle.
• Search Live: Have a live, real-time conversation in Search by using your voice and camera to easily get answers and on-screen links to the web when you need them.
• AI Overviews: Get a snapshot of key information about a topic or question, like ’how to fix a broken zipper’, with links so you can easily explore more on the web.
• Hum to Search: Can't remember the name of that song? Hum the tune and Google will help find it for you—no lyrics, artist name or perfect pitch required. You can also search for a song playing near you.
• Discover: Stay up-to-date on topics that matter to you. Get personalized news, articles, and videos based on your interests.
• Google Search Widget: Search faster from your home screen or lock screen, with easy shortcuts to AI Mode, Lens, and more.

Google Search, totally reimagined with AI

• Explore a new intelligent Search box that expands with your curiosity, offers AI powered suggestions and lets you search with text, videos and more.
• Bring your toughest questions to Search. With a more seamless Search experience, you can go from an AI Overview on the search results page to asking follow-up questions in AI Mode, with links to the web.
• Get help with planning, researching, brainstorming new ideas, and more with the latest Gemini models delivering frontier performance for agents and coding.

Search what you see with Google Lens:

• Use your camera to identify what you’re looking at. Identify plants and animals, translate text in real-time, find similar products to buy, and even solve math problems with step-by-step guides.
• Translate over 100 languages on things like road signs when you travel, menus, and more by pointing your camera at text.
• Reverse image search: Find the source, similar photos, and related information for any image.
• Get step-by-step homework help on math, physics and word problems, and testing your knowledge with Questions and Answers are now fully supported within the Google app.

Search safely and securely:

• All searches in the Google app are protected by encrypting the connection between your device and Google.
• Privacy controls are easy to find and use. Tap your profile picture to access your menu and delete recent search history from your account with one click.
• Search proactively filters webspam to help ensure that you see safe, high-quality results.


Learn more about what the Google app can do for you: https://search.google/

Privacy policy: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy

name: X
description:
X (formerly Twitter) is a social media app where you can follow breaking news, live events, and trending topics as they happen. Sports, tech, music, politics: whatever you're into, the conversation starts here, raw and unfiltered.

It's also a place to be heard. Post your take on the day's news, go live, and grow an audience for whatever you create. Millions of people come to X every day to find out what's happening and talk about it.


WHAT YOU CAN DO ON X

- Follow breaking news – Get news from around the world before it hits the headlines, with real-time updates on trending topics and viral conversations.
- Post to a global community – Share your thoughts, photos, and videos. Join millions of users shaping public dialogue across social, cultural, and political conversations.
- Ask Grok – Grok is the AI assistant powered by X's real-time data. Ask Grok to summarize trending news, explain videos, or give you more context about posts. Grok also powers the photo and video editing tools in the app.
- Create original videos – The built-in Video Editor and Recorder lets you shoot, add multi-language captions, apply green screen effects, and post pro-level content directly in the app.
- Go live on video – Stream a concert, a live game, or your thoughts on a hot topic, and keep your audience engaged with enhanced livestream tools.
- Watch video and podcasts – From live breaking news and sports clips to podcasts and gaming sessions up to 3 hours long. Many of the world's leading voices in comedy, gaming, podcasting, and politics share their content on X.
- Host live audio with Spaces – Spaces is X's audio feature for hosting discussions, holding interviews, or starting your next live podcast.
- Message privately – Connect and chat with friends, followers, customers, or collaborators through Direct Messages.
- Pin Custom Timelines – Custom Timelines are Grok-powered topic feeds you can pin for the topics you follow most.
- Turn on Priority Notifications – Priority Notifications surface your key interactions first.
- Open your History tab – The History tab is one unified place for your bookmarks, likes, videos, and articles.
- Subscribe to X Premium – X Premium unlocks a blue checkmark, boosted visibility, prioritized replies, fewer ads, longer videos, and post editing. It also gives you creator revenue sharing and the ability to offer exclusive content to subscribers.

WHO X IS FOR

X is for people who follow breaking news and live events in real time, for sports, tech, music, and politics fans, for creators and podcasters who stream and create original video content for an audience, and for anyone building a community around gaming, entertainment, crypto, entrepreneurship, or tech.

WHY X?

In a world of constant change, X is your real-time source to stay ahead of the curve, connect with people, explore diverse perspectives, and create standout content. From breaking live news and trending memes to top podcasts, live streams, and original videos from your favorite creators, X brings it all together in one powerful social experience.

• Transfer accounts between devices with a QR code. This is a convenient way to move your accounts to a new device.


To use Google Authenticator with Google, you need to enable 2-Step Verification on your Google Account. To get started, visit http://www.google.com/2step

description:
MobileSheets is the ultimate sheet music viewer for Android tablets. It frees you from having to lug around books and binders, and gives you the ability to access any score in your library in seconds. It also comes with a number of powerful features for musicians including:
    - Multiple modes of operation including two pages side-by-side, half page turns, and vertically scrolling pages.
    - Hands-free page turns using any bluetooth or usb devices (including two and four pedal models), through the automatic scrolling feature, or through face gestures such as an open mouth or smile.
    - Annotations for marking up music including support for freeform drawing, basic shapes, text and stamps
    - A custom audio player for playing audio tracks with your scores. Audio player supports a-b looping and multiple sizes.
    - Custom page ordering, making it easy to cut out unnecessary pages, repeat pages or change the sequence of pages without affecting the original document.
    - A metronome with multiple display modes and sound effects
    - Bookmarks for quick and easy access to sections in scores
    - Link points for handling repeats and quickly jumping between pages
    - Smart buttons that can be placed on a score to activate configurable actions when pressed
    - Support for multiple file types including images, PDFs, text files and chord pro files. 
    - Support for importing CSV index files to break up large PDF songbooks
    - Support for communicating with MIDI devices over USB to load songs or trigger actions.
    - The ability to transpose chords in text and chord pro files.
    - Manual and automatic cropping to completely eliminate unnecessary margins
    - Support for setlists and collections to efficiently group songs for playback. 
    - Powerful library management features with a huge list of supported metadata fields, giving you complete control over the data in your library
    - A free companion application for the PC that makes it a breeze to create and edit songs
    
MobileSheets acts as a file manager for your sheet music files (PDFs, images or text/chord pro files) and links directly to them on the device. It provides a way to organize and quickly access any of those files. MobileSheets can be configured to use existing files and folders on the device storage, allowing those files to be organized as desired by the user without them having to be copied or moved.

Give MobileSheets a try today and experience the freedom of having all your scores just a simple tap away.
    
NOTE: This application is designed and optimized for 7" and larger tablets. This application does not include any sheet music - you must provide your own. This application can not play back PDFs, images or text/chord pro files. It can only display those files and play back audio files.

Terms of Use: https://zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/terms_and_conditions_android.html

1: Reboot your tablet
2: Go to your tablet Settings->Applications->Google Play and tap Clear Data. Do the same for Google Play Services.

4: If the installation still does not work, reboot your tablet and try again

name: Meowdoku: Brain Puzzle Games
summary: A pure logic puzzle blending Sudoku & Minesweeper! Find every cat's territory.
description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.
Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
💡 Simple Rules, Deep Strategy
The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!
✨ Key Features
🐾 Pure & Immersive Experience
- Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
- Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.
📅 Daily Brain Teasers
- Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
- Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards.
❤️ Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone
Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind.
Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines?
Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

Your passengers have specific destinations and transfer between your lines. Wait times, the routes they take and full vehicles all affect their satisfaction. Keep an eye on demand, adjust how your vehicles are deployed and improve your service where it's needed.

YOUR COMPANY, YOUR DECISIONS
Set ticket prices, keep track of revenue and operating costs, and invest in your next expansion. Choose operating hours and run your fleet automatically or tailored to the time of day. Strike the balance between an attractive service and a profitable operation.

Complete goals, reach milestones and earn stars for research, new areas and upgrades. Unlock more vehicle categories and open up more and more of your city.

name: GOV.UK One Login
summary: Prove your identity and save government documents to your phone.
description:
You can use the GOV.UK One Login app to prove your identity to access some government services. It works by matching your face to your photo ID.

You can also use this app to save a digital version of your HM Armed Forces Veteran Card to your phone. 

In future you'll be able to save other digital documents, such as your driving licence. This is not available yet.


Before you start

You need to get this app if you’re:
• using a service on the GOV.UK website that asks you to prove your identity with GOV.UK One Login
• saving your digital Veteran Card to your phone

You’ll be guided to this app when it is time to use it.

What you need

You can use any of the following types of photo ID to prove your identity:
• UK passport
• non-UK passport with a biometric chip
• UK photocard driving licence
• UK biometric residence permit (BRP)
• UK biometric residence card (BRC)
• UK Frontier Worker permit (FWP)

You can use an expired driving licence if it expired in the last 90 days and it was issued by DVLA.

You can use an expired BRP, BRC or FWP up to 24 months after its expiry date.

You need to have your original photo ID with you. You cannot use a photocopy or digital copy.


You will also need:
• a well-lit area where you can take a good quality photograph
• an Android phone running Android version 10 or higher

How it works

You'll need to sign in to the app with your GOV.UK One Login details. This links the app to the GOV.UK website so you can continue proving your identity.

If your photo ID is a passport, BRP, BRC or FWP you will:
• take a photo of your photo ID
• scan the biometric chip in your photo ID using your phone
• scan your face using your phone

If your photo ID is a driving licence you will:
• take a photo of your driving licence
• scan your face using your phone

What happens next

Once your information has been submitted in the app, you'll need to go back to the GOV.UK website, so you can finish proving your identity and access the service you were trying to use.

Privacy and security

The personal information you provide to prove your identity will not be saved either on the app or on your phone. We collect your data securely and delete it when it is no longer needed.

Digital documents you add to the app will be saved on your phone so you can access them whenever you need.

You can also log in through the NHS website on a computer to use NHS App services.

Access NHS services
----------------------
Use the NHS App to access your NHS services, anytime and anywhere. You can request repeat prescriptions, use 111 online, find nearby NHS services and more.

Depending on your GP surgery, you may also be able to book appointments and contact your surgery about a health problem.

Manage your health
--------------------

You can manage your upcoming appointments and prescription requests. You can also make choices about your health, like your organ donation decision.

Receive messages
-------------------

Manage services for other people
---------------------------------
You can switch profiles to access services for other people in the NHS App, such as a child or family member. Your GP surgery needs to give you access and you must both share the same surgery.

Log in securely

The NHS App will guide you through setting up an NHS login if you do not have one already. You will be asked to prove who you are. The app will then securely connect to information from your NHS services.

If your Android device supports fingerprint, face or iris recognition, you can use it to log in, every time you use the app.

name: Microsoft Authenticator
summary: No more passwords, easier sign-in, and greater protection for your accounts.
description:
Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication or passwordless. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work or school accounts.

Getting started with multi-factor authentication

Multi factor authentication (MFA) or two factor authentication (2FA) provides a second layer of security. When logging in with multi-factor authentication, you’ll enter your password, and then you’ll be asked for an additional way to prove it’s really you. Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The one-time passwords (OTP codes) have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The one-time password (OTP) doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.

Getting started with passwordless

Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.

Microsoft personal, work or school accounts

Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain files, emails, or apps. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator also supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each. Because Microsoft Authenticator supports single sign-on, once you have proven your identity once, you will not need to log in again to other Microsoft apps on your device.

Optional Access Permissions

Microsoft Authenticator includes the following optional access permissions. All these require user consent. If you choose to not grant these optional access permissions, you can still use Microsoft Authenticator for other services that do not require such permission. For more information see https://aka.ms/authappfaq

Location: Sometimes your organization wants to know your location before allowing you to access certain resources. The app will request this permission only if your organization has a policy requiring location.

Camera: Used to scan QR codes when you add a work, school, or non-Microsoft account.

Read the contents of your storage: This permission is only used when you report a technical problem through the app settings. Some information from your storage is collected to diagnose the issue.
